scope: Reviewed operator-provided synthetic host export; no live host Docker attestation
assessment: Automatic title generation can overlap main inference and trip the mandatory single-inference limit. The pinned CLI and execution gateway reproduce the same one-request/zero-tool denial with a delayed fixed-text model fixture. Supplying the supported native --title option removes the contention and permits initial execution and continuation without changing concurrency or budgets.
limitations: The original host execution record did not capture a denial reason, so its precise historical branch cannot be established from that record alone.
The controlled regression uses fixed text responses with every tool denied: it is not coding or real Ollama inference.
The corrected real OpenCode/Ollama host trial remains pending.
